# meshagent_flutter

**Tag**: web, mobile, ui

## 简介

Widgets for bootstraping Meshagent Flutter apps: secure room sync, live documents, and messaging in a ready-to-use SDK.

## 官网

- 主页: https://www.meshagent.com
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/meshagent_flutter
